The '''Nobuuri irstat''' was a [[Tarasin]] [[irstat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It was located near the [[Hiironi irstat]] and was visited by [[Dariana]] when she was a Tarasin [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]].
